object_description: compact multipurpose-room volume connected to an existing school building
design_condition: Located on the eastern part of the grounds and linked to the existing building by a covered passage, the volume defines a generous square that connects the surrounding buildings.

positive.statement: The project fits correctly into the existing school complex and completes its spatial sequences simply and organically.

position.rationale: The connected low-rise volume is anchored on the eastern side of the existing complex.

positive.statement: The precisely located multipurpose room defines a generous square with convincing dimensions and positioning.

position.rationale: The large eastern square volume is clearly identifiable in the top view.

positive.statement: The sober architectural character responds to the tender requirements and expectations.

position.rationale: Simple rectilinear connected massing is visible across plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The compactness of the buildings is good and the modular arrangement offers potential for optimization.

position.rationale: Repeated compact volumes and regular horizontal bands visibly support modularity.

negative.statement: The lightness of the load-bearing structures is not apparently supported by sufficient structural development.

position.rationale: Structural development is not distinguishable, so the connected building frame is used as an approximate anchor.

negative.statement: Some spaces are slightly oversized, although their modularity allows them to be optimized.

position.rationale: Potentially oversized spaces are approximated within the identifiable multipurpose-room volume.
